Measured on `php -n` 8.5.6, which /// also prints `NoCast::stream_cast is not implemented!` and `Cannot represent a stream of type /// user-space as a select()able descriptor` first — two warnings elephc does not emit yet. #[test] fn test_stream_select_wrapper_without_stream_cast_excluded() { let out = compile_and_run( r#"<?php class NoCast { public $context; public function stream_open($path, $mode, $options, &$opened): bool { return true; } public function stream_eof(): bool { return false; } public function stream_read(int $n): string { return ""; } } stream_wrapper_register("nocast", "NoCast"); $w = fopen("nocast://x", "r"); $r = [$w]; $wr = []; $e = []; try { $n = stream_select($r, $wr, $e, 0, 0); echo "n=" . $n . " kept=" . count($r); } catch (ValueError $e) { echo get_class($e), ": ", $e->getMessage(); } "#, ); assert_eq!(out, "ValueError: No stream arrays were passed"); }
